verdict.rationale: Apify's docs explicitly state you can 'Check the performance of your Actors, validate data quality, and receive alerts,' directly matching the story, and this is backed by concrete mechanisms like webhooks that trigger actions on run success/failure, log streaming, and error-handling subclasses in the client libraries. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence validating the monitoring/alerting UI or data-quality validation features in practice, and no detail on what 'alerts' channels (email/Slack/etc.) are supported.
